resources.string: The selected file is empty. Choose a file that contains book text.
Choose an EPUB or TXT file.
The file could not be read or saved. Check file access and available storage, then select it again.
The book files could not be saved. Free up storage and select the file again.
The text cannot be read with this encoding. Try another encoding.
This text encoding is not supported. Choose an encoding from the list.
The chapter rule is invalid or uses unsupported syntax. Edit it or restore the default rule.
The chapter rule is too long. Shorten it to 1,024 characters or fewer.
No readable content was found. Check the file contents; for TXT, also check the encoding and chapter rule.
The EPUB is incomplete or damaged. Download or export the original file again.
This EPUB contains encrypted text or images and cannot be imported.
This EPUB contains a resource format NextVol cannot read. Try exporting it as a standard EPUB with local text and images.
The device ran out of memory while reading this EPUB.
This import session has ended. Go back and select the original file again.
The selected bookshelf is no longer available. Go back and choose a bookshelf again.
The book could not be imported. Select the file again to retry. Diagnostic details are available below.
